name: guarded-saucer-swap
description: A Hedera testnet HBAR-to-SAUCE starter with live SaucerSwap V1 quotes, HTS association checks, and on-chain swap policy.

steps.label: Fund a Hedera testnet wallet before deployment

steps.text: Copy packages/nextjs/.env.example to packages/nextjs/.env.local to use the public testnet guard. Connect a funded ECDSA testnet wallet; the app can request SAUCE association before a guarded swap. To deploy your own guard, follow README.md.
